learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-11-16 lists as newest item: "Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in December" (Fri, 13 Nov 2026 20:40:05 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The system plan should audit current usage of GitHub Copilot models to identify any reliance on those scheduled for deprecation in December and map out necessary model upgrades or transitions without executing any live configuration changes.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
